name: Painted in White
source:
Painted in White is a short visual novel inspired by cute shoujo-ai ("Girl's Love") slice of life anime like Yuru Yuri. Similar to many of these shows, Painted in White follows the story of a few girls and their developing friendship. Follow Tomogi and her friends, Kuu, Petra, and Asagi through their comical adventures!

[Edited from [url=https://tophatstudios.itch.io/painted-in-white]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Painted in White》是一部短篇视觉小说，灵感来自《Yuru Yuri》等可爱的shoujo-ai（“女孩的爱”）生活动画片段。与许多此类节目类似，《白画》讲述了几个女孩的故事以及她们发展友谊的故事。跟随Tomogi和她的朋友Kuu、Petra和Asagi经历他们的滑稽冒险！

[编辑自[url=https://tophatstudios.itch.io/painted-in-white]itch.io[/url]]
